Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

simling 0.1.2

  • New data set fuzzy_contrasts: articulatory trajectories (linear discriminant values from ultrasound images) of GOOSE and FOOT before /l/ in four morphological contexts in Southern British English, after Strycharczuk and Scobbie (2017). Durations and the numbers of speakers with each contrast follow the paper.
  • ?disfluencies, ?rhythm_metrics and ?word_order now cite Di Napoli (2020), Rathcke and Smith (2015) and Dryer (2013) in the text.
  • README: simling has 57 data sets from 20+ branches of linguistics.
  • The scripts in data-raw/ use the tidyverse throughout: purrr instead of loops and apply functions, joins and case_when() instead of index lookups, and stringr instead of base string functions. They reproduce the data exactly. data-raw/session_info.txt lists the R and package versions used.
  • german_plurals$article, korean_stops$vot and mandarin_tones$duration no longer carry a stray names attribute. Their values are unchanged.
  • ?price_f2, ?visual_world and ?mandarin_tones give the SD of the AR(1) innovations as well as the SD of the residuals.
  • ?iterated_learning gives the starting number of distinct words in each condition, the size of its decline and its variation between chains.
  • ?lexical_decision_l2 gives the range of length in the data (3 to 12).
  • ?reading_skipping says that first fixations are log-normal around the values from Rayner et al. (2011).
  • Help pages cite in the text all of the works they list, and reference lists are in alphabetical order. The two Ehret and Taboada (2021) works are now 2021a and 2021b. The scripts in data-raw/ cite the same works as their help pages.
  • New titles: ?lexical_accuracy (“Italian lexical decision accuracy”), ?word_order (“Word order across 400 invented languages”) and ?hungarian_harmony (“A wug test of Hungarian vowel harmony”).
  • README lists the packages needed to rebuild the data.

simling 0.1.1

  • simling can be installed from R-universe (https://mcanzi.r-universe.dev).
  • New data set web_registers: 16 lexico-grammatical features in 480 texts from six web registers, for factor analysis in the style of a multi-dimensional analysis. Its parameters are based on the web register data of Ehret and Taboada (2021).
  • New hex logo: an orange cut in half, in the sunset colours of mcanzi.de.
  • ?pupil_noise gives the SD of the AR(1) residuals (20) as well as the SD of the innovations (12) used to simulate them.
  • citation("simling") takes the version number from DESCRIPTION.

simling 0.1.0

  • First version, with 55 simulated data sets: 53 from 20 branches of linguistics, a meta-analysis and a messy export for data cleaning.
  • simling_datasets() lists the data sets with their branch, language, size, response and topic.
  • Every data set comes with the code that generated it (data-raw/) and a help page listing its variables, its true model and its references.
  • Each help page has an example that fits the model the data were simulated from, or summarises the pattern the page describes, so its output can be compared with the true values. Examples that need a package other than base R run only when that package is installed.
